meta.title: Roleplay chat
meta.description: A lightweight roleplay chat with freely configurable character cards — install and play. Three dialogue lengths, a one-tap tension boost, an optional explicit-content switch (with model-fit hints), a consistent second-person address for the player, supporting-character viewpoint control, automatic memory, a character status bar, and a sense of the actual current time and date. Memory, conversations and character cards are all kept in the browser's local storage: nothing is written to disk, and switching browsers or clearing browser data wipes them. Pair with the Multi-character story add-on to let several characters interact together.
